```{r setup, include=FALSE}
fmt_p   <- function(x) ifelse(x < .001, "< .001",
                              sub("^0", "", sprintf("= %.3f", x)))
fmt_pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x)
fmt_rt <- function(x) {
  out <- character(length(x))
  bad <- is.na(x) | is.nan(x) | !is.finite(x)
  out[bad] <- "NA"
  out[!bad] <- sprintf("%d ms", as.integer(round(x[!bad] * 1000)))
  out
}

fmt_chi <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
fmt_p_apa <- function(x) ifelse(x < .001, "< .001",
                                sub("^0", "", sprintf("= %.3f", x)))
# Skips quietly when a figure has not been generated, so the document can be
# knitted while the figure set is being decided.
fig <- function(name) {
  p <- file.path(NEWFIG, name)
  if (file.exists(p)) knitr::include_graphics(p) else invisible(NULL)
}

get_nmc <- function(model_name, effect_name, src) {
  src |> filter(model == model_name, effect == effect_name) |> slice(1)
}

and_list <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  if (n == 0) return("")
  if (n == 1) return(x[1])
  if (n == 2) return(paste(x, collapse = " and "))
  paste0(paste(x[-n], collapse = ", "), ", and ", x[n])
}

or_list <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  if (n == 0) return("")
  if (n == 1) return(x[1])
  if (n == 2) return(paste(x, collapse = " or "))
  paste0(paste(x[-n], collapse = ", "), ", or ", x[n])
}

nmc_effect <- function(model_name, term, label, kind, src) {
  r <- get_nmc(model_name, term, src)
  if (nrow(r) == 0) return(NULL)
  list(label = label, kind = kind, sig = r$p < .05,
       stat = sprintf("[χ²(%d) = %s; *p* %s]",
                      r$df, fmt_chi(r$chisq), fmt_p_apa(r$p)))
}

nmc_prose <- function(model_name, effects, src, lead = "The analysis") {
  e <- Filter(Negate(is.null),
              lapply(effects, function(x)
                nmc_effect(model_name, x[[1]], x[[2]], x[[3]], src)))
  if (length(e) == 0) return("")
  sig  <- Filter(function(z)  z$sig, e)
  nsig <- Filter(function(z) !z$sig, e)
  labstat <- function(z) paste(z$label, z$stat)

  if (length(sig) == 0) {
    return(sprintf("%s revealed no significant effects of %s.",
                   lead, or_list(vapply(e, labstat, character(1)))))
  }

  sm <- Filter(function(z) z$kind == "main", sig)
  si <- Filter(function(z) z$kind != "main", sig)
  chunks <- character(0)
  if (length(sm) == 1)
    chunks <- c(chunks, sprintf("a significant main effect of %s", labstat(sm[[1]])))
  if (length(sm) > 1)
    chunks <- c(chunks, sprintf("significant main effects of %s",
                               and_list(vapply(sm, labstat, character(1)))))
  if (length(si) == 1)
    chunks <- c(chunks, sprintf("a significant %s interaction", labstat(si[[1]])))
  if (length(si) > 1)
    chunks <- c(chunks, sprintf("significant %s interactions",
                               and_list(vapply(si, labstat, character(1)))))
  out <- sprintf("%s revealed %s.", lead, and_list(chunks))

  nm <- Filter(function(z) z$kind == "main", nsig)
  ni <- Filter(function(z) z$kind != "main", nsig)
  if (length(nm))
    out <- paste(out, sprintf("The main effect%s of %s %s not significant.",
                              if (length(nm) > 1) "s" else "",
                              and_list(vapply(nm, labstat, character(1))),
                              if (length(nm) > 1) "were" else "was"))
  if (length(ni))
    out <- paste(out, sprintf("The %s interaction%s %s not significant.",
                              and_list(vapply(ni, labstat, character(1))),
                              if (length(ni) > 1) "s" else "",
                              if (length(ni) > 1) "were" else "was"))
  out
}

r2_text <- function(model_name) {
  r <- glmm$r2_summary |> filter(model == model_name) |> slice(1)
  sprintf("marginal R² = %.2f; conditional R² = %.2f",
          r$R2_marginal, r$R2_conditional)
}


COND_NAME_LABELS <- c(
  "cond_name1" = "parox / N+ / V+",
  "cond_name2" = "parox / N− / V+",
  "cond_name3" = "parox / N+ / V−",
  "cond_name4" = "oxy / N+ / V+",
  "cond_name5" = "oxy / N− / V+"
)

relabel_terms <- function(df) {
  df |>
    dplyr::mutate(term = dplyr::recode(term, !!!COND_NAME_LABELS))
}
```

# Method

## Participants

`r n_participants` participants completed the experiment: `r n_l1` L1 Spanish speakers and `r n_l2` L2 Spanish learners.

## Procedure

Three-phase Spanish stress-suffix association task in PsychoPy: pre-test (360 trials, 6 blocks), training (120 trials with feedback), post-test (360 trials, parallel structure). On each trial, participants heard a spoken stimulus and selected *PRESENTE* or *PASADO*.

Pre/post stimuli were drawn from six conditions varying in verb stress (paroxytone, oxytone), noun match (Match, Mismatch), and verb match (Match, Mismatch). Training stimuli were two conditions: `parox` (a) and `oxy` (b).

```{r legend-table}
kable(cond_legend_prepost,
      caption = "Table 1. Condition coding for pre- and post-test stimuli.",
      col.names = c("Cond", "Name", "Verb stress", "Verb match", "Suffix tense", "Noun match", "Splice"),
      align = c("c", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "c"))
```

```{r legend-table-train}
kable(cond_legend_training,
      caption = "Table 2. Condition coding for training stimuli.",
      col.names = c("Cond", "Name", "Verb stress", "Tense"),
      align = c("c", "l", "l", "l"))
```

# Summary of Findings

## General Description

Accuracy and RT data from the pre- and post-test phases were analyzed using generalized linear mixed-effects models in R with the `lme4` package. Accuracy (binary correct/incorrect) was modeled with a binomial family and logit link. RT on correct trials (200–5000 ms) was modeled with a Gaussian family on log-transformed RT. Gamma and inverse Gaussian GLMMs on untransformed RT were fit for comparison, following Lo and Andrews (2015), but both were underdispersed (DHARMa dispersion 0.59 and 0.11 respectively, both p < .001) whereas the lognormal model was not (0.94, p = .308). All three families agreed on every effect. Predicted RTs are therefore geometric means, and RT effects are multiplicative. Training-phase accuracy was modeled with a binomial-logit growth-curve GLMM with standardized trial number as a continuous predictor. All models included group (L1, L2), phase (pre, post), their interaction, and condition (6 levels) as fixed effects; the training model included group, trial_z, and their interaction. All categorical predictors used sum-to-zero contrasts so that coefficients represent deviations from the grand mean. Random-effects structure: by-participant intercepts and slopes for phase (or trial in the training model) and by-item intercepts. Model assumptions were assessed with the `DHARMa` package using scaled quantile residuals; QQ-plots and dispersion tests were used to evaluate fit. Statistical significance of main effects and interactions was assessed via nested model comparisons; main effects involved in interactions were tested against a no-interaction model to preserve marginality. Marginal and conditional R² were calculated following Nakagawa and Schielzeth (2013). Decision rule: α = .05.

## Results

```{r summary-results, results='asis', eval=has_glmm}
primary <- list(
  list("group",       "group",         "main"),
  list("phase",       "phase",         "main"),
  list("cond_name",   "condition",     "main"),
  list("group:phase", "group × phase", "int")
)
training <- list(
  list("group",         "group",              "main"),
  list("trial_z",       "trial",              "main"),
  list("group:trial_z", "group × trial", "int")
)

cat(sprintf("The accuracy model was fit with a maximal error term (%s). %s ",
            r2_text("accuracy"), nmc_prose("accuracy", primary, glmm$nmc_all)))
cat(sprintf("The RT model was fit with a maximal error term (%s). %s ",
            r2_text("rt"), nmc_prose("rt", primary, glmm$nmc_all)))
cat(sprintf("The training-phase model was fit with a maximal error term (%s). %s\n\n",
            r2_text("training"), nmc_prose("training", training, glmm$nmc_all)))
```

```{r summary-followup, results='asis', eval=has_followup}
vm <- function(v) list(
  list(paste0("group:", v),       paste("group ×", sub("_", " ", v)),                 "int"),
  list(paste0("phase:", v),       paste("phase ×", sub("_", " ", v)),                 "int"),
  list(paste0("group:phase:", v), paste("group × phase ×", sub("_", " ", v)),    "int")
)
sv <- list(
  list("verb_stress",             "verb stress",                          "main"),
  list("verb_match",              "verb match",                           "main"),
  list("verb_stress:verb_match",  "verb stress × verb match",        "int")
)
gsv <- list(
  list("group:verb_stress",                  "group × verb stress",                     "int"),
  list("group:verb_match",                   "group × verb match",                      "int"),
  list("verb_stress:verb_match",             "verb stress × verb match",                "int"),
  list("group:verb_stress:verb_match",       "group × verb stress × verb match",   "int")
)

cat("Four follow-up analyses examined the verb-mismatch and noun-mismatch effects on accuracy and RT. ")
cat(nmc_prose("acc_verbmatch",  vm("verb_match"), followup$nmc_followup,
              "The verb-match accuracy model"), "")
cat(nmc_prose("rt_verbmatch",   vm("verb_match"), followup$nmc_followup,
              "The verb-match RT model"), "")
cat(nmc_prose("acc_nounmatch",  vm("noun_match"), followup$nmc_followup,
              "The noun-match accuracy model"), "")
cat(nmc_prose("rt_nounmatch",   vm("noun_match"), followup$nmc_followup,
              "The noun-match RT model"), "")
cat(nmc_prose("acc_stress_vm",  sv,  followup$nmc_followup,
              "The verb-stress × verb-match accuracy model"), "")
cat(nmc_prose("rt_stress_vm",   sv,  followup$nmc_followup,
              "The verb-stress × verb-match RT model"), "")
cat(nmc_prose("acc_g_s_vm",     gsv, followup$nmc_followup,
              "The group × verb-stress × verb-match accuracy model"), "")
cat(nmc_prose("rt_g_s_vm",      gsv, followup$nmc_followup,
              "The group × verb-stress × verb-match RT model"), "\n\n")
```

```{r acc-results, results='asis', eval=has_glmm}
nmc_group <- get_nmc("accuracy", "group", glmm$nmc_all)
nmc_phase <- get_nmc("accuracy", "phase", glmm$nmc_all)
nmc_int   <- get_nmc("accuracy", "group:phase", glmm$nmc_all)
nmc_cond  <- get_nmc("accuracy", "cond_name", glmm$nmc_all)

cat("**Effects on accuracy (NMC):**\n\n")
cat(sprintf("- Group: χ²(%d) = %s, *p* %s\n",
            nmc_group$df, fmt_chi(nmc_group$chisq), fmt_p_apa(nmc_group$p)))
cat(sprintf("- Phase: χ²(%d) = %s, *p* %s\n",
            nmc_phase$df, fmt_chi(nmc_phase$chisq), fmt_p_apa(nmc_phase$p)))
cat(sprintf("- Group × Phase: χ²(%d) = %s, *p* %s\n",
            nmc_int$df, fmt_chi(nmc_int$chisq), fmt_p_apa(nmc_int$p)))
cat(sprintf("- Condition: χ²(%d) = %s, *p* %s\n\n",
            nmc_cond$df, fmt_chi(nmc_cond$chisq), fmt_p_apa(nmc_cond$p)))

cat("**Direction:** L2 accuracy increased from pre to post; L1 accuracy was stable. Condition main effect present.\n\n")
```

```{r rt-results, results='asis', eval=has_glmm}
            nmc_group$df, fmt_chi(nmc_group$chisq), fmt_p_apa(nmc_group$p)))

            nmc_cond$df, fmt_chi(nmc_cond$chisq), fmt_p_apa(nmc_cond$p)))

cat("**Direction:** L1 faster than L2 overall. Both groups faster at post than at pre. Condition main effect present.\n\n")
```

# Follow-Up: Verb- and Noun-Mismatch Effects

Follow-up analyses examined the verb-mismatch and noun-mismatch effects on accuracy and RT. Four pairs of models test (a) `group × phase × verb_match`, (b) `group × phase × noun_match`, (c) `verb_stress × verb_match`, and (d) `group × verb_stress × verb_match`. Mismatch cost convention: positive cost = mismatch worse than match (= prediction surprise). RT cost = Mismatch − Match (ms); accuracy cost = Match − Mismatch (percentage points).

```{r q1-results, results='asis', eval=has_followup}
nmc_acc_3way <- get_nmc("acc_verbmatch", "group:phase:verb_match", followup$nmc_followup)
nmc_acc_g    <- get_nmc("acc_verbmatch", "group:verb_match",       followup$nmc_followup)
nmc_acc_p    <- get_nmc("acc_verbmatch", "phase:verb_match",       followup$nmc_followup)
nmc_rt_3way  <- get_nmc("rt_verbmatch",  "group:phase:verb_match", followup$nmc_followup)
nmc_rt_g     <- get_nmc("rt_verbmatch",  "group:verb_match",       followup$nmc_followup)
nmc_rt_p     <- get_nmc("rt_verbmatch",  "phase:verb_match",       followup$nmc_followup)

cat("**Accuracy effects (NMC):**\n\n")
cat(sprintf("- Group × verb match: χ²(%d) = %s, *p* %s\n",
            nmc_acc_g$df, fmt_chi(nmc_acc_g$chisq), fmt_p_apa(nmc_acc_g$p)))
cat(sprintf("- Phase × verb match: χ²(%d) = %s, *p* %s\n",
            nmc_acc_p$df, fmt_chi(nmc_acc_p$chisq), fmt_p_apa(nmc_acc_p$p)))
cat(sprintf("- Group × Phase × verb match: χ²(%d) = %s, *p* %s\n\n",
            nmc_acc_3way$df, fmt_chi(nmc_acc_3way$chisq), fmt_p_apa(nmc_acc_3way$p)))

cat("**RT effects (NMC):**\n\n")
cat(sprintf("- Group × verb match: χ²(%d) = %s, *p* %s\n",
            nmc_rt_g$df, fmt_chi(nmc_rt_g$chisq), fmt_p_apa(nmc_rt_g$p)))
cat(sprintf("- Phase × verb match: χ²(%d) = %s, *p* %s\n",
            nmc_rt_p$df, fmt_chi(nmc_rt_p$chisq), fmt_p_apa(nmc_rt_p$p)))
cat(sprintf("- Group × Phase × verb match: χ²(%d) = %s, *p* %s\n\n",
            nmc_rt_3way$df, fmt_chi(nmc_rt_3way$chisq), fmt_p_apa(nmc_rt_3way$p)))

cat("**Direction (RT):** L1 showed a larger verb-mismatch cost than L2 overall. Verb-mismatch cost was larger at post than at pre. The pattern of growth from pre to post was similar in both groups.\n\n")
```

# Training: Non-Linear Learning Curves

The linear growth curve above assumes accuracy and RT change at a constant rate across the 120 training trials. Generalised additive mixed models were fit to test that assumption, with a smooth over trial and a by-group difference smooth. `group` was coded as an ordered factor, so the first smooth is the L1 curve and the second is the L2 departure from it.

```{r gamm-edf-table, eval=has_gamm}
gamm$edf_table |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  kable(caption = "Training GAMM smooth terms. An edf of 1 means the smooth collapsed to a straight line.")
```

```{r gamm-results, results='asis', eval=has_gamm}
e <- gamm$edf_table
grab <- function(model, pattern) {
  r <- e[e$model == model & grepl(pattern, e$smooth), ][1, ]
  sprintf("edf = %.2f, *p* %s", r$edf, fmt_p_apa(r$`p-value`))
}
cat(sprintf(
"The accuracy smooth over trial returned %s, so the learning curve is linear and the growth-curve GLMM above is the appropriate model. The RT smooth returned %s. The group difference smooth was %s for accuracy and %s for RT, so the two groups follow the same trajectory in both measures.\n\n",
  grab("accuracy", "^s\\(trial\\)$"),
  grab("rt", "^s\\(trial\\)$"),
  grab("accuracy", "group_ord"),
  grab("rt", "group_ord")))
```

```{r fig-gamm-acc, fig.cap="Training accuracy, GAMM fit. Grey points are observed means in 10-trial bins.", eval=has_gamm}
fig("fig20_gamm_accuracy.png")
```

```{r fig-gamm-rt, fig.cap="Training reaction time, GAMM fit. Grey points are observed means in 10-trial bins.", eval=has_gamm}
fig("fig5_training_rt.png")
```

```{r fig-gamm-diff-acc, fig.cap="Training accuracy, L2 minus L1 difference smooth with 95% CI.", eval=has_gamm}
fig("fig22_gamm_diff_accuracy.png")
```

```{r fig-gamm-diff-rt, fig.cap="Training reaction time, L2 minus L1 difference smooth with 95% CI.", eval=has_gamm}
fig("fig6_training_diff.png")
```

# Per-Participant Summary

```{r pp-table}
pp_tbl <- by_pp |>
  mutate(
    Accuracy       = fmt_pct(accuracy),
    `RT correct`   = fmt_rt(rt_correct),
    `RT incorrect` = fmt_rt(rt_incorrect),
    `RT all`       = fmt_rt(rt_all),
    Phase          = stringr::str_to_title(as.character(phase))
  ) |>
  select(Participant = participant, Group = group, Phase,
         `n trials` = n_trials, `n incorrect` = n_incorrect,
         Accuracy, `RT correct`, `RT incorrect`, `RT all`)

kable(pp_tbl,
      caption = "Per-participant accuracy and RT by phase.",
      align = c("r", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"))
```
